limitations: Unsigned prototype artifact identities and app 1.5.2 remain separate from the v1.5.3 release candidate.
Recovery helper is a maintainer-only experiment, not shipped in native package payloads; production auto-recovery and quarantine retention remain undecided.

Requires stopped package writers, an exclusive quiescent root-controlled fixture and read-only verified payload; path-based preflight/hash/rename is not resistant to concurrent privileged filesystem changes.
Whole-container SIGKILL at recorded prepare/real-RPM-unpack boundaries does not establish exhaustive physical power-loss, disk-full or filesystem durability behavior.
Synthetic ALSA/PortAudio and private Pulse/GStreamer checks exclude JACK, physical cameras/microphones, desktop PipeWire user-session behavior and native app audio acceptance.
Hardware execution covers the unchanged pinned CUDA payload on RTX3080/5070 with driver595.91.07, not every supported GPU/driver/model.
Full local CPU suite disabled device visibility; an earlier host-GPU-enabled attempt exposed unrelated user CUDA13 headers/NVRTC mismatch and is retained as failed, not qualified.
Payload size/pruning, signed publication/updater ownership, native ELF dependencies, Zypper/EL, real model acceptance and TensorRT remain unqualified.
Prototype codec/NVIDIA/model redistribution and pinned private-Python license inventory do not inherit the separate release candidate licensing changes.
